infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Cubeit turns your voice messages into text using on-device speech recognition. Audio never leaves this phone.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Cubeit uses the microphone only while you record a voice message. It's turned into text on this phone and the recording is deleted.
